categories.main_business_segments: MayAir Technology (China) Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the air purification industry, focusing on industrial-grade ultra-clean technology for semiconductor cleanrooms, biopharmaceutical cleanrooms, commercial indoor air quality, and atmospheric pollution control. Key product lines include fan filter units (FFU), various filters (primary, medium, high-efficiency, electrostatic, chemical), air purification equipment, industrial dust and oil mist removal devices, and VOCs treatment systems. The company also provides integrated cleanroom solutions and services across semiconductor, biopharmaceutical, public health, and commercial sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies such as high-efficiency and ultra-high-efficiency filtration, FFU energy-saving and noise reduction systems, computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulation, electrostatic adsorption, modified filter media including PTFE membranes and nano-fiber materials, activated carbon adsorption, ion exchange fiber technology, and catalytic oxidation for VOCs decomposition. Manufacturing involves advanced production lines with automation upgrades, including laser cutting, flexible stamping, automated welding, and intelligent warehouse management. The company maintains 31 specialized R&D labs and holds numerous patents covering filtration, cleanroom systems, and air purification technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: MayAir serves leading semiconductor manufacturers, biopharmaceutical companies, public healthcare institutions, commercial buildings, data centers, and industries requiring high air cleanliness standards. Its customers include major domestic and international semiconductor fabs, new energy and photovoltaic firms, food processing plants, hospitals, airports, museums, and high-end office buildings. The company is a qualified supplier to multiple global semiconductor and new energy enterprises and has a significant presence in both domestic and overseas markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with nine domestic production bases and two overseas manufacturing facilities in Malaysia and Canada. It has sales and service subsidiaries in Singapore, Thailand, Japan, the UK, the US, and Hong Kong, targeting Southeast Asia, North America, Europe, and the Middle East. Overseas revenue accounted for approximately RMB 228 million in 2024, reflecting rapid international market expansion, especially in Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: MayAir operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the air purification supply chain. It procures core raw materials such as fans, filter media, aluminum profiles, and adhesives, some of which are co-developed or domestically produced to replace imports. The company manufactures key components like fan filter units and filters and provides integrated cleanroom solutions, serving as a critical supplier to semiconductor fabs and other end users requiring ultra-clean environments.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in new filtration materials (e.g., activated carbon regeneration, ion exchange fibers, PTFE membranes, nano-fiber composites), air pollution control technologies (VOCs treatment, dust and oil mist removal), biomedical and public health air purification solutions, and digital air quality monitoring leveraging IoT and 5G. It aims to enhance energy efficiency, noise reduction, and system integration of FFUs, expand upstream filter media production, and develop intelligent, digitalized air purification systems. The company also focuses on global market expansion and supply chain integration through acquisitions and strategic partnerships.
categories.revenue_model: MayAir generates revenue primarily through direct sales of air purification products including fan filter units, filters, and air purification equipment. It employs a direct sales model supplemented by limited OEM production for mature products and some distribution channels for replacement parts. Revenue is recognized upon delivery and acceptance of products or completion of services. The company also derives recurring revenue from consumable filter replacements and after-sales system integration services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic supplier in the semiconductor cleanroom air purification market, competing with international brands such as AAF and Camfil. It holds a strong position in China’s semiconductor and biopharmaceutical sectors with products and technologies comparable to global benchmarks. The industry is fragmented but competitive, with increasing concentration and a shift towards integrated cleanroom solutions. MayAir’s strategic acquisitions and R&D capabilities strengthen its competitive edge and market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, MayAir achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.723 billion, a 14.45% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 191.99 million, up 10.83%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 3.699 billion, growing 23.68%, with net assets of RMB 1.792 billion, up 9.73%. R&D expenses accounted for 4.52% of revenue, reflecting sustained investment. The company’s overseas revenue and production capacity have expanded rapidly, supporting a positive growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: MayAir emphasizes its comprehensive cleanroom air purification solutions with advanced filtration technologies that achieve ultra-high filtration efficiency (up to 99.999997% for 0.1-micron particles) and superior energy efficiency (over 15% energy savings compared to generic products). Its proprietary filter media modification technologies extend product life and enhance pollutant adsorption. The company offers integrated system solutions from core components to full cleanroom infrastructure, backed by extensive certifications and a strong service network. Its globalized management team and international certifications support competitive positioning in domestic and overseas markets.
